# Element Access

There are many ways elements in a JSON value can be accessed:

- unchecked access via [`operator[]`](01-doing/00-华威科实习/01-项目工作台/05-参考资料/ROS-git-worktree/src/VTLA_octopus-master/octopus/3rdparty/json/docs/mkdocs/docs/features/element_access/unchecked_access.md)
- checked access via [`at`](01-doing/00-华威科实习/01-项目工作台/05-参考资料/ROS-git-worktree/src/VTLA_octopus-master/octopus/3rdparty/json/docs/mkdocs/docs/features/element_access/checked_access.md)
- access with default value via [`value`](01-doing/00-华威科实习/01-项目工作台/05-参考资料/ROS-git-worktree/src/VTLA_octopus-master/octopus/3rdparty/json/docs/mkdocs/docs/features/element_access/default_value.md)
- iterators
- JSON pointers
